name: MATTHS 26
source:
Kevvz transfers to a college in Western Massachusetts, hoping to put his faith into something and commit to a decision for once. What he couldn't have ever predicted was the way his concept of events would manifest reality itself.

[From [url=https://ebicon.itch.io/matths-26]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
凯夫兹转学到了马萨诸塞州西部的一所大学，盼望着能找到值得寄托信念的事物，真真正正地贯彻一次自己的决定。然而他做梦也没有料到，自己对事态的认知竟会直接将现实本身具现化。

[摘自[url=https://ebicon.itch.io/matths-26]itch.io[/url]]
